{
  "candidate_rtl": "module decoder_8bit
 #(
    parameter N = 8
) (
    input [N-1:0] in,
    output reg [(1<<N)-1:0] out
);
    reg [15:0] low_onehot;

    always @(*) begin
        low_onehot = 16'b1 << in[3:0];
        out = {{(1<<N)-1{1'b0}}, 1'b0};
        case (in[7:4])
            4'h0: out[15:0]    = low_onehot;
            4'h1: out[31:16]   = low_onehot;
            4'h2: out[47:32]   = low_onehot;
            4'h3: out[63:48]   = low_onehot;
            4'h4: out[79:64]   = low_onehot;
            4'h5: out[95:80]   = low_onehot;
            4'h6: out[111:96]  = low_onehot;
            4'h7: out[127:112] = low_onehot;
            4'h8: out[143:128] = low_onehot;
            4'h9: out[159:144] = low_onehot;
            4'hA: out[175:160] = low_onehot;
            4'hB: out[191:176] = low_onehot;
            4'hC: out[207:192] = low_onehot;
            4'hD: out[223:208] = low_onehot;
            4'hE: out[239:224] = low_onehot;
            4'hF: out[255:240] = low_onehot;
            default: ;
        endcase
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The original variable-width 256-bit left shift can map to a deep, high-fanout barrel-shifter network across all eight input bits.",
  "rewrite": "Predecode the lower four input bits once into a 16-bit one-hot value, then select one 16-bit output bank using the upper four input bits. This exposes shared decoder structure and avoids replicating a full 256-bit shift at every stage.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Likely improvement in maximum data arrival through reduced select depth and localized 16-bit routing, subject to mapper factoring and buffering.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "May use modestly more or comparable area than the original implementation because of the explicit intermediate 16-bit decoder and bank-selection logic; all outputs are still combinational and fully assigned.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For N=8, every binary input from 8'h00 through 8'hFF produces exactly one asserted output bit at index in, with all other bits cleared. The zero initialization preserves the default behavior, and the 16-bit lower decode plus 16-way upper bank selection exactly matches the original 256-bit shift, including input values at both endpoints."
